CL2: contextual applicability with typed guarantees and no individual-truth coercion

CL4: selective reevaluation outside the transitive dependency cone

controls: same advertised operator identity with different prompt behavior
missing, revoked and conflicting checker judgments
unrooted cycle versus independently rooted alternate support
